memberdef.argsstring: (struct tt_bitset_iterator *it, struct tt_bitset_expr *expr, struct tt_bitset **p_bitsets, size_t bitsets_size)
memberdef.name: tt_bitset_iterator_init

briefdescription.para: Initialize the it using expr and bitsets and rewind the iterator to the start position.

simplesect.para: It is safe to reinitialize an iterator with a new expression and new bitsets. All internal buffers are safely reused in this case with minimal number of new allocations.
expr object is only used during initialization time and can be safetly reused or destroyed just after this call.

parameterdescription.para: array of pointers to bitsets that should be used to bind the expression parameters.

briefdescription.para: Rewind the it to the start position.
Move it to a next position.

simplesect.para: the next offset where the expression evaluates to true or SIZE_MAX if there is no more bits in the result set.
